paragraphs.text: Drivnod , also called the Dominus of Pain , is a Phyrexian Horror on New Phyrexia .

When Phyrexia reshaped the surface of Mirrodin, parts of the very land took on a mind of its own. Entire mountains began to move, becoming godlike Phyrexian creatures known as the Domini . No one knows what the Domini are or whether they think and desire the same way other Phyrexians do.

Drivnod grew out of the skeletal, necrogen -drenched architecture of the Dross Pits . He is a grinning, spiked titan who takes pleasure in torturing lesser life forms. He impales his victims on his staff and conducts them like an orchestra in a symphony of agonized screams.

At rest, his burnished bones shift and murmur in the wind. He smells strongly of rot. His staff is a towering, razor-edged monolith, and the bodies of skitterlings, aspirants - including Belaxis , and a single Phyrexian priest hang from it. Each of them was chosen and placed with care, as the dominus craves their screams of agony.
